crossRefs.note: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib…
Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah…

people.name: Berechiah
people.line: Israelite who helped repair Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Hananiah
people.line: Shelemiah's son, helped repair Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Hanun
people.line: Another repairer of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

people.name: Meshullam
people.line: Helped repair the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah.

people.name: Shelemiah
people.line: Levite who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Zalaph
people.line: Father of Hanun, who repaired Jerusalem's wall

translations.web: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.
translations.bsb: Next to him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, as well as Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. Next to them, Meshullam son of Berechiah made repairs opposite his own quarters.
translations.kjv: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
translations.asv: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another portion. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
